implemented_stages: document inventory with Unicode-safe filename/reference handling
content SHA-256 registration and deterministic document-version identity
page-level extraction warnings and suspicious/empty quality flags
semantic fragment construction with parent heading and table-header context
deterministic fragment IDs and source anchors
immutable snapshot manifests with corpus boundary checks
test_fixture_coverage: technical multi-page PDF generated in tests
ruled table with repeated headers in table-row fragments
deterministic source-button fragment -> version -> page/source resolution
duplicate same-page text with distinct bboxes
long condition kept as one semantic fragment
corrupted PDF rejection and missing-bbox tolerance
known_parser_limitations: pdfplumber is a text-PDF baseline; OCR and universal scanned-page recovery are intentionally not implemented
heading and semantic-kind detection uses conservative heuristics and requires review for complex documents
table extraction depends on PDF geometry and may emit TABLE_STRUCTURE_WARNING for incomplete cells
embedding-token counts are an approximate character-based planning estimate until a tokenizer benchmark exists
cross-page fragments are not merged; page provenance remains exact
real organizer corpus was not ingested

source_resolution_result.returns: original filename/reference, document version, page range, section, canonical text and source anchor

snapshot_semantics.id_strategy: snapshot ID is a hash of corpus plus sorted document-version IDs

identifier_strategy.document: stable Unicode-normalized logical filename identity; filesystem path is provenance only
identifier_strategy.document_version: hash of document identity, content SHA-256 and declared version/date
identifier_strategy.fragment: hash of document version, page/anchor, section and canonical text hash
